text: {"C1":{"score":10,"justification":"The agent greets, names the company and herself, and offers help in the opening line.","evidence":"Muy buenas tardes, gracias por llamar a Seguros Confianza, le atiende Valeria Cisneros, para servirle. ¿En qué le puedo ayudar?"},"C2":{"score":10,"justification":"The agent gathered both vehicles, current coverage and deductibles, current premium, usage, and claims history, then explicitly summarized to confirm understanding before proposing.","evidence":"Entonces resumo: Mazda 3 2022 y HR-V 2023, ambos amplia, uso personal, sin siniestros, hoy pagan tres mil cuatrocientos en total."},"C3":{"score":5,"justification":"The recording disclosure was given at the very end of the call rather than near the start, but no prohibited statements were made since the price was explicitly conditioned on underwriting.","evidence":"Ah, por cierto, antes de que se me pase: le comento que esta llamada puede ser grabada con fines de calidad, es un aviso que le debo dar."},"C4":{"score":10,"justification":"A concrete next step was set with a specific owner, deliverable, and timeframe.","evidence":"Le mando la cotización formal de ambos a su correo ahorita... Y le llamo el jueves a las cinco para resolver dudas"},"C5":{"score":10,"justification":"The agent was courteous, structured the call clearly, and addressed the customer's skepticism calmly without escalation.","evidence":"No hay trampa, el descuento multi-vehículo existe precisamente para juntar pólizas."}}
